plain: Mercy shown to a wrongdoer, as when a leader spares or reduces a punishment

webster.text: Mildness; softness; as the clemency of the air.

more.text: Mercy; disposition to treat with lenity, to forgive or to spare, as offenders; tenderness in punishing; opposed to severity, harshness, or rigor.

example.quote: On the other hand, when the sedition had proceeded from causes which had inflamed the resentments of the major party, they might often be found obstinate and inexorable, when policy demanded a conduct of forbearance and clemency.
